Container.Name: streamflow
Container.Overview: Automated IPTV stream management for Dispatcharr. Match streams with regex or TVG-ID, measure stream quality, manage provider capacity, schedule checks and monitor playback. Requires an existing Dispatcharr instance reachable from the container. Configure the connection in StreamFlow's setup wizard after installation.
Container.Requires: An existing Dispatcharr instance reachable from this container.

Branch.TagDescription: Development builds; review changes before updating.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the StreamFlow web interface. Change this if port 5000 is already in use.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent database, settings, regex rules and playback history. Use a separate directory for each StreamFlow installation.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID used to run StreamFlow. The default is Unraid's nobody user.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID used to run StreamFlow. The default is Unraid's users group.
